# requirements.md - Artifact Contract

Produced by: Jira Story Analyzer (Skill 1)
Consumed by: Playwright Browser Exploration (Skill 2)

This file is the authoritative, append-only record of business intent for one request. Once written, it becomes the sole source of requirement truth for every downstream Skill - no downstream Skill may query Jira or Confluence directly.

---

## Story

<!-- Jira Story ID, title, and reporter/source reference. -->

## Description

<!-- Full narrative description of the requirement, as stated in Jira/Confluence. -->

## Acceptance Criteria

<!-- Numbered or bulleted list. Each criterion must be individually referenceable (e.g. AC-1, AC-2) so test-plan.md and testcases.json can cite it. -->

## Business Rules

<!-- Constraints, invariants, and domain rules the implementation must respect. -->

## URLs

<!-- Application URLs referenced or implied by the story. -->

## Test Data

<!-- Sample values, edge cases, or data constraints mentioned in the story. -->

## Validation Messages

<!-- Expected error/success/warning messages, if specified. -->

## User Workflows

<!-- Step-by-step user journeys implied by the story. -->

## Assumptions

<!-- Anything inferred rather than explicitly stated. Must be clearly marked as an assumption, never presented as fact. -->

## Risks

<!-- Ambiguities, dependencies, or areas likely to need clarification before automation. -->
